Real-Time Detection of Robot Failures Using Gaze Dynamics in Collaborative Tasks

← Publications

Ramtin Tabatabaei, Vassilis Kostakos, and Wafa Johal · ACM/IEEE HRI 2025

Research context

This work explores gaze dynamics as a signal for detecting robot failures in real time during collaborative tasks.

It forms part of my research on gaze-based robot failure detection, including the use of a random forest classifier to identify failures from human behavioural signals.

Ramtin Tabatabaei · Melbourne, Australia
